title: DoorwayHealthP2P
description: The cached elohim-storage P2P status embedded in doorway GET /health. Source of truth: doorway's timestamped observation of the storage /p2p/status operational surface (Category C); reconstructed on every health read, never persisted. stale=true means this cache block is unavailable or older than two 60-second sync rounds.

enabled.description: Whether doorway last observed P2P as enabled in its storage sidecar.

peerCount.description: Connected P2P peer count in doorway's last storage observation.

peerId.description: Storage node peer ID, when the cached status supplied one.

caughtUp.description: True when the last reconcile sweep ended; exhausted gaps may still remain.

converged.description: True only when no reconcile gap is pending or exhausted. Absent until the storage sidecar supports it.

divergentAnchor.description: Anchor divergence count from the last storage observation.

observedAgeMs.description: Milliseconds since doorway observed this storage status; omitted when no snapshot can be read.

stale.description: True when no snapshot is available or it is more than two sync rounds old.
